title: Newhalo pinned sequence
description: A pinned product story on black: a window-tall dark picture stays fixed while a 100px white heading and then a few short captions (line icon, 24px title, paragraph) scroll past it on the left. Each caption fades and rises in at the middle of the window and dims as it leaves; the picture blooms in at the start.
notes: about 2.5–3 screens tall; the picture is sized by the window (h-svh) and sticks
the original scrubs an image sequence inside the pinned frame: put a canvas or video in the media slot
